This coastal reserve is home to one of the world's largest breeding colonies of noisy Cape fur seals.

From this viewpoint on the stark Atlantic shore, visitors can overlook a massive, churning colony of fur seals.

Protejând kilometri de plajă cu nisip, această rezervație naturală garantează un loc de reproducere sigur pentru mii de mamifere marine.
Protecting miles of sandy beach, this nature reserve guarantees a safe breeding ground for thousands of marine mammals.
